name: Loony Laps
summary:
Loony Laps is a playful miniature racing game built for both VR and Mixed Reality.

Take control of tiny cars and race across colorful tabletop tracks packed with jumps, hazards, obstacles and ridiculous surprises. Cars can get smashed, thrown around, transformed and sent flying as every race turns into its own little spectacle.

Play through championships, unlock new cars and tracks, or jump straight into a Quick Race or Time Trial.
